name: signalk-pypilot-newui
description: Signal K friendly UI for the pypilot autopilot, with the capability to spread its functions and buttons to other programs like KIP, WilhelmSK and freeboard. Touch-first mobile visor + full pypilot data (servo, gains, calibration, tack, warnings) as first-class Signal K paths and Simple Switches. Coexists with pypilot-autopilot-provider.

screenshots.title: Control - compass rose with Gota Chain (amber A = apparent wind, teal T = true wind), sailing wedges, 4 configurable corner tiles, big-touch AP button and heading trim buttons
Chart - Trip Stats cards (engaged time, distance, energy, RMS/p95 heading error, servo runtime, tacks/gybes, max servo A) plus live Servo Health baseline
Tune - PID gain sliders per pilot/profile, locked-by-default with orange 'was:' baseline, ±10/±1 fine-tune buttons

Setup - launcher grid with live-summary tiles for Autopilot Check, Diagnostics & Advice (Pypilot Doctor), Sensor Quality, Alarms, Connection, Calibration, Signal K Sentences, Language and Remote Control Console
Race - T1/T2 countdown timer with beeps and spoken seconds, background-persistent across tabs
Info - safety notice, quick-start guide, coexistence with pypilot-autopilot-provider, credits and license
